entries.source: Codex diplomaticus et epistolaris Moraviae - Urkundensammlung zur Geschichte Mährens, Nr. CXXXVI. , S. 178, CXXXVI.
entries.german: CXXXVH. Johannes, papa XXII. suscipit monasterium Oslawanense ord. Cisterciens. in suam protectionem confirmatque omnia illius bona. Dt. Avinione III. Nonas Julii 1318. (Orig. membran. cum bulta plumbea in arcbivo civitatis Brunse, 0. I. n. 19.)
entries.english: CXXXVII. Pope John XXII takes the Cistercian monastery of Oslavany under his protection and confirms all its possessions. Issued at Avignon on 5 July 1318. Original on parchment with a lead bull in the archive of the city of Brno, O. I. no. 19.
